findings.description: `total = sum(1 for _ in lines)` iterates the whole `lines` iterable. The CLI passes an open file object, which is a one-shot iterator. After the count it is exhausted, so the `for line in lines` loop at line 54 sees no lines. The output is empty and stats.read is 0, while progress reports 0/total.
findings.suggestion: Avoid the pre-pass: pass total as an optional argument, or materialize the lines into a list (at the cost of memory), or seek the file back to the start. Alternatively drop the total from the progress callback.
findings.title: Counting lines consumes a one-shot iterator, so nothing is processed

findings.description: In the except branch, `return enrich(event, geo)` is missing `await`. enrich_one therefore returns a coroutine object. The retry never runs inside the semaphore, a second LookupTimeout is never raised in this task so it cannot abort the run as documented, and `sink` receives a coroutine rather than an Event. `to_json` then fails or writes garbage, and a 'coroutine was never awaited' warning appears.
findings.suggestion: Use `return await enrich(event, geo)` so the retry runs under the semaphore and a second timeout propagates.
findings.title: Retry returns an un-awaited coroutine instead of the Event
